name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central income-support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families. The encoded demo rule checks occupation only; official exclusion rules must also be verified.
benefits: Eligible farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments through direct benefit transfer.
application_steps: Open the official PM-KISAN portal or visit an authorised CSC.
Complete farmer registration and provide land and bank details.
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC when required.
Track beneficiary status on the official portal.
source_excerpt: PM-KISAN provides ₹6,000 per year per eligible farmer family in three instalments. Eligibility exclusions remain subject to the official guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for eligible unorganised workers.
benefits: Minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after attaining 60 years, subject to regular contributions and official conditions.
application_steps: Visit the official Maandhan portal or nearest CSC.
Provide Aadhaar, savings-bank details and occupation information.
Choose the contribution mandate and complete enrolment.
Keep the pension account details safely.
source_excerpt: Entry age is 18–40 years and monthly income must be ₹15,000 or below. The scheme is voluntary and contributory.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Support programme for artisans and craftspeople working in listed family-based traditional trades in the unorganised sector.
benefits: Recognition, skill training, toolkit incentive, credit support, digital-transaction incentives and marketing support, subject to official conditions.
application_steps: Visit a Common Service Centre for biometric registration.
Complete verification by local bodies and the designated committees.
Receive the Vishwakarma certificate and ID after approval.
Select applicable skilling, toolkit and credit benefits.
source_excerpt: The beneficiary must be at least 18 and engaged in one of the listed traditional trades. Other official exclusions also apply.

name: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojana
description: Bihar state crop-assistance programme intended to protect cultivators from notified crop loss due to natural calamities.
benefits: Crop-loss assistance according to the notified season, crop, loss assessment and official Bihar government rules.
application_steps: Check the current season notification on the Bihar Cooperative Department portal.
Register using identity, bank, land or cultivation details.
Select the notified crop and submit the application before the deadline.
Keep the acknowledgement for status tracking.
source_excerpt: The Bihar programme protects crops cultivated in Bihar against notified natural calamities. Seasonal notifications control applications.

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Institutional credit facility intended to provide timely credit for agricultural and allied activities.
benefits: Access to need-based, timely bank credit for cultivation and permitted allied activities, subject to lender assessment.
application_steps: Approach a participating bank or use its official KCC application channel.
Submit identity, address, land or activity and crop details.
The bank assesses the credit limit and repayment terms.
Review all bank terms before accepting the facility.
source_excerpt: KCC is intended to provide adequate and timely credit support for agricultural operations and eligible allied activities.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Working-capital support programme for eligible street vendors, with incentives linked to timely repayment and digital transactions.
benefits: Collateral-free working-capital loan progression and applicable repayment or digital-transaction incentives, subject to current programme rules.
application_steps: Confirm vendor identification or obtain the required recommendation document from the urban local body.
Apply through the official portal, a CSC or participating lender.
Complete lender verification and review loan terms.
Repay on schedule to remain eligible for applicable progression benefits.
source_excerpt: PM SVANidhi supports eligible street vendors through working-capital credit. Vendor identification and lender checks apply.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank-loan facilitation for eligible women or Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs establishing greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Facilitation of bank loans for eligible greenfield enterprises, subject to bank appraisal and current scheme rules.
application_steps: Review eligibility and prepare a greenfield business proposal.
Apply through the Stand-Up Mitra portal or a scheduled commercial bank branch.
Provide promoter, category or gender, ownership and project documents.
The bank independently appraises and decides the loan.
source_excerpt: The programme targets eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises. Bank appraisal is mandatory.

name: National Scholarship Portal – Post-Matric Opportunities
description: A discovery entry for post-matric scholarship opportunities listed through the National Scholarship Portal. Each component has separate rules and deadlines.
benefits: Scholarship benefits vary by ministry, state, category, course, institution and family-income criteria.
application_steps: Open the National Scholarship Portal and complete One-Time Registration when available.
Select only the scholarship whose rules match your course and profile.
Upload the required identity, academic, category and income documents.
Submit before the displayed deadline and track institute or department verification.
source_excerpt: NSP hosts multiple scholarship components. JanScope does not combine them into one eligibility promise; users must verify the selected component.
